run_f_gold: run f_gold to count trailing zeroes in the factorial of a given number n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter set of 10 test cases
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold uses Legendre formula to count trailing zeroes in n factorial
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use integer division instead of float division for cleaner arithmetic
review_f_gold: review f_gold and the test harness that compares f_filled output against the gold reference
